rules.H-main: As built in #756 (ours today): d = the Quote's need rounded up; a block across L grows d, and so does one ending on L that starts on or above the Quote's top; a block that starts below L stays; any other block ending on or below L moves d (so one starting on L moves, and one ending on L that starts below the Quote's top moves).
rules.H-stay: For a Quote only the blocks across L grow d; every other block stays (s1's lower Shape and s2's upper Shape stay). d as H-main.
rules.H-round: d = the Quote's overflow rounded to the nearest row, as for a Text (s3: 1, s4: 3); the rest as H-main.

note: Areas are desktop areas in the read's block order (Quote first).
